facts.text: Past the chasm, cairns lead up and to the left behind the false summit; wandering right of the chasm or straight up the chockstone drifts into low fifth-class.
In early October parties used a short rope for the chasm, and some stepped over the chockstone beside the gap instead of leaping it.
Early October: clean, dry scrambling with little rockfall, but short days left one party reaching the top with barely any daylight.

notes: No harvested track is a complete or one-way trip from a trailhead: every in-season summit track starts at a camp (Tungsten Mine, Airview Lake, Upper Cathedral Lake) or at Cathedral Pass, so no track assigned. Best partial candidates are listed under Southwest Route (2635577, 2654845) and SE Buttress (2573798). Tracks starting near 48.872,-120.003 at ~1,700 m are the Tungsten Mine camp, not a trailhead; no trailhead pin nominated. The Monk routes are filed under Cathedral Peak but are a different summit; their pins lack a Monk summit coordinate. The stored Southwest Route text already covers the chasm well, so facts are limited to what it lacks.
